'''Grommash "Grom" Hellscream''' was the chieftain of the [[Warsong clan]], a powerful blademaster and best friend and chief advisor to Warchief [[Thrall]]. He was one of the chieftains who had gladly taken the blood of [[Mannoroth|Mannoroth the Destructor]], thus binding the Horde to the Burning Legion - and he would eventually pay the ultimate price to free himself and his people from the Blood Curse.
